title: New Gaza documentary co-produced by the Guardian premieres at festival
seoTitle: Guardian Gaza documentary premieres in Venice
subtitle: Film investigates bombings in Gaza and is directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor
excerpt: New documentary produced by the Guardian and directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor will have its world premiere at the Venice Film Festival.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A new documentary about Israel's bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is set to receive its world premiere at the Venice Film Festival.

The film, titled NAZA, investigates what is described as the calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians by Israel during the war. The production is directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of 'No Other Land' alongside Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal.

The work was produced with Jim Wilson and has executive production by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind 'The Zone of Interest'. The documentary is the only one to address the subject at the event.

With information from The Guardian.
